Rachel — good capture. A couple of operational rules to apply when we accept in Partner Center: 

- Quota carve: split priority into Tier A (owned by Strategic sellers) and Tier B (Growth sellers). For ACME, because ARR > $400k, flag as Tier A.
- Lead prioritization: If contact has active Azure credit approval or is pilot-ready in 60 days, bump score +20.
- Conflict resolution: if multiple owners, default to the seller with existing renewal/relationship history.

I can join Wed 14 9am PT. Vanessa — can you bring the latest seller roster and any recent marketplace closures that might intersect?

Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
